metadata.title: Trastuzumab Deruxtecan 5.4 mg/kg (Enhertu) Therapy
metadata.indication: Monotherapy for eligible adult patients with unresectable or metastatic HER2-positive or HER2-low breast cancer in the NCCP-defined treatment settings.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled · independent clinical/pharmacy review pending

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant. Dose must not be re-escalated after reduction.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding of NCCP regimen 00776 v3b. It does not replace the NCCP regimen, clinical judgement, local policy, prescribing review or pharmacy verification.

history_ild_pneumonitis.label: History of ILD or pneumonitis before starting this regimen

anc.label: ANC (×10⁹/L)
anc.assessment_guidance: NCCP00776 Table3 uses CTCAE v5.0: ANC0.5–<1.0 is Grade3; ANC<0.5 is Grade4. Use these dose-table bands, not the different CTCAE v6.0 educational thresholds. Fever/infection needs separate urgent assessment.

temperature_38_duration_hours.label: Duration temperature ≥38°C (hours)
temperature_38_duration_hours.grading_source_label: NCCP 00776 timing criterion · not a toxicity grade
temperature_38_duration_hours.source_grading_note: This is elapsed time at temperature≥38°C, not a temperature measurement or CTCAE grade. The NCCP febrile-neutropenia condition uses ANC<1.0 and temperature>38.3°C, or temperature≥38°C sustained for more than1hour.
temperature_38_duration_hours.assessment_guidance: This is elapsed time at temperature≥38°C, not a temperature measurement or CTCAE grade. The NCCP febrile-neutropenia condition uses ANC<1.0 and temperature>38.3°C, or temperature≥38°C sustained for more than1hour.

ild_pneumonitis_grade.label: Current ILD/pneumonitis grade
ild_pneumonitis_grade.assessment_guidance: Assess new cough, breathlessness, oxygen requirement and imaging, while considering infection and other causes. Trastuzumab-deruxtecan-related ILD requires prompt evaluation; symptomatic disease permanently stops treatment under NCCP.

ild_grade1_resolution_days.label: Days from previous Grade 1 ILD onset to complete resolution
ild_grade1_resolution_days.assessment_guidance: This is a count of days from a previous Grade1 ILD episode to complete resolution, not a toxicity grade. Grade0 recovery is required before resumption; ≤28days permits the same dose and >28days a one-level reduction.
ild_grade1_resolution_days.grading_source_label: NCCP 00776 timing criterion · not a toxicity grade
ild_grade1_resolution_days.source_grading_note: This is a count of days from a previous Grade1 ILD episode to complete resolution, not a toxicity grade. Grade0 recovery is required before resumption; ≤28days permits the same dose and >28days a one-level reduction.

lvef_drop_points.label: Absolute LVEF decrease from baseline (percentage points)

platelets.label: Platelets
platelets.assessment_guidance: NCCP and current EMA sources require FBC review but do not give a platelet-specific dose ladder for this drug. Platelet results require clinical assessment; do not infer a US-label dose algorithm or regard an entered value as clearance.

hb_g_dl.label: Haemoglobin
hb_g_dl.assessment_guidance: Review anaemia and symptoms clinically; no Hb-specific dose algorithm is supplied by NCCP00776.

crcl_ml_min.label: Creatinine clearance category

options.label: 30–<60 mL/min — no reduction; closer ILD monitoring

crcl_ml_min.assessment_guidance: Use verified creatinine clearance. NCCP separates ≥30 from <30mL/min and dialysis; EMA adds enhanced toxicity/ILD monitoring for moderate impairment (30–<60mL/min). Do not infer a band without a verified renal calculation.
crcl_ml_min.help: The selector preserves these source-specific thresholds. Numeric input remains supported; renal results alone do not clear other assessment domains.

prior_anti_her2_regimen.label: HER2-positive pathway: at least one prior anti-HER2 regimen

prior_metastatic_chemotherapy.label: HER2-low pathway: previous chemotherapy for metastatic disease

recurrence_within6mo_adjuvant_chemo.label: HER2-low pathway: recurrence during or within 6 months of adjuvant chemotherapy

cord_compression_or_active_cns.label: Spinal cord compression or untreated/symptomatic CNS metastases

suspected_ild_pneumonitis.label: New pulmonary symptoms or imaging suggesting ILD / pneumonitis

previous_symptomatic_ild.label: Previous treatment-related symptomatic ILD, even if now resolved
previous_symptomatic_ild.assessment_guidance: Historical symptomatic ILD means Grade2 or greater under NCCP/EMA and permanently excludes rechallenge. This yes/no history input is not the current toxicity grade.

confirmed_severe_lvef_recheck.label: Repeat assessment confirms LVEF <40% or >20-point decline

lvef_40_45_recheck.label: Repeat after initial LVEF 40–45% with 10–20-point decline

options.label: Recovered to within 10 points of baseline
Not recovered to within 10 points of baseline

further_dose_reduction_required.label: A further dose reduction is clinically required

bilirubin_ratio_uln.label: Bilirubin
bilirubin_ratio_uln.assessment_guidance: Use the measured bilirubin and laboratory ULN; the interface calculates the multiple. EMA has limited data above1.5×ULN, irrespective of AST.

output_templates.proceed: No encoded contraindication or hold criterion was triggered. Complete normal prescribing and pharmacy checks.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue for a severe infusion-related reaction.

action.recommendation: Permanently discontinue for symptomatic Grade ≥2 ILD/pneumonitis. Promptly initiate corticosteroids under specialist care (EMA example: prednisolone ≥1 mg/kg/day or equivalent for at least 14 days, then taper for at least 4 weeks). Do not rechallenge after symptomatic ILD.

rules.explanation: Permanently discontinue for symptomatic Grade ≥2 ILD/pneumonitis. Promptly initiate corticosteroids under specialist care (EMA example: prednisolone ≥1 mg/kg/day or equivalent for at least 14 days, then taper for at least 4 weeks). Do not rechallenge after symptomatic ILD.

action.recommendation: Previous Grade 1 ILD took >28 days to resolve: after confirmation of Grade 0, reduce one dose level. No re-escalation; if already at 3.2 mg/kg, discontinue.

rules.explanation: Previous Grade 1 ILD took >28 days to resolve: after confirmation of Grade 0, reduce one dose level. No re-escalation; if already at 3.2 mg/kg, discontinue.

action.recommendation: Withhold for asymptomatic Grade 1 ILD until Grade 0. Consider corticosteroids promptly (EMA example: prednisolone ≥0.5 mg/kg/day or equivalent); investigate with CT and respiratory input. If resolved within 28 days resume same dose; if >28 days reduce one level. These are clinician instructions, not a patient self-treatment plan.

rules.explanation: Withhold for asymptomatic Grade 1 ILD until Grade 0. Consider corticosteroids promptly (EMA example: prednisolone ≥0.5 mg/kg/day or equivalent); investigate with CT and respiratory input. If resolved within 28 days resume same dose; if >28 days reduce one level. These are clinician instructions, not a patient self-treatment plan.

action.recommendation: Withhold for ANC<0.5 ×10⁹/L until ANC≥1.0 (Grade ≤2), then reduce one dose level. If already at 3.2 mg/kg and further reduction is required, discontinue.

rules.explanation: Withhold for ANC<0.5 ×10⁹/L until ANC≥1.0 (Grade ≤2), then reduce one dose level. If already at 3.2 mg/kg and further reduction is required, discontinue.

action.recommendation: Withhold for ANC 0.5 to <1.0 ×10⁹/L until ANC≥1.0 (Grade ≤2), then maintain the current dose. Assess fever/infection separately.

rules.explanation: Withhold for ANC 0.5 to <1.0 ×10⁹/L until ANC≥1.0 (Grade ≤2), then maintain the current dose. Assess fever/infection separately.

action.recommendation: Febrile neutropenia criterion met: interrupt until resolved, then reduce one dose level. Arrange urgent clinical assessment and manage suspected neutropenic sepsis under local policy; do not wait for a threshold-duration test to seek help.

rules.explanation: Interrupt for LVEF <40%; repeat within 3 weeks. If confirmed, permanently discontinue.

action.recommendation: Severe hepatic impairment: trastuzumab deruxtecan is not recommended.

action.recommendation: NCCP expects no adjustment for moderate hepatic impairment with close toxicity monitoring. EMA states that dose requirements with bilirubin>1.5×ULN cannot be determined due to limited data. Reconcile the category and source difference with oncology/pharmacy; do not calculate a dose automatically.

action.recommendation: A further reduction below 3.2 mg/kg is required: permanently discontinue. Do not re-escalate following a reduction.

action.recommendation: Previous Grade 1 ILD resolved within 28 days: after confirming complete Grade 0 recovery and no prior symptomatic ILD, the same dose may resume. Continue pulmonary surveillance; all other domains remain to be assessed.

action.recommendation: Withhold while suspected ILD/pneumonitis is urgently evaluated. Arrange radiographic investigation, preferably CT, consider respiratory consultation and corticosteroids according to grade. Do not wait for the next routine scan.

action.recommendation: After the specified initial LVEF 40–45%/10–20-point decline and treatment interruption, recovery to within 10 points permits same-dose resumption following clinical review. This pathway does not override confirmed severe dysfunction or symptomatic CHF.

supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for high emetogenic risk
summary: High emetic risk: prescribe prophylaxis before each infusion and a delayed/breakthrough nausea plan using the linked NCCP high-risk pathway and local pharmacy policy.
EMA specifically recommends combined antiemetics before every dose; the earlier abbreviated medication list was not a complete prescription.
Pulmonary symptom education and Enhertu patient alert card; baseline/12 weekly cardiac surveillance.
No generic G-CSF requirement inferred; consider individual risk and previous neutropenia under local policy.
supportive_care.provenance: National NCCP antiemetic guidance is linked for antiemetic support. Confirm regimen specific supportive care against the current NCCP protocol and applicable local policy.
supportive_care.mapping_basis: The active ADC is high emetogenic risk in NCCP V6 Table 7.

indications.description: Unresectable/metastatic HER2-positive breast cancer after one or more anti-HER2 regimens.
Unresectable/metastatic HER2-low breast cancer after metastatic chemotherapy, or recurrence during/within 6 months of adjuvant chemotherapy.

treatment_phases.name: Trastuzumab deruxtecan
treatment_phases.label: Day 1 every 21 days
treatment_phases.duration: Until disease progression or unacceptable toxicity

administration.notes: First infusion90 minutes; subsequent infusions30 minutes if tolerated. Use0.20/0.22micron PES/PS filter. Not interchangeable with trastuzumab or T-DM1. No home pump.

baseline: ECHO/MUGA LVEF before first dose; NCCP eligibility≥50%.
Pregnancy test where applicable; establish HER2 result, previous therapy, pulmonary history and baseline respiratory symptoms.
regular: FBC, renal/liver profile before every 21-day cycle.

ECHO/MUGA every 12 weeks; 4–8 weekly if signs of cardiac impairment. At an uninterrupted21-day schedule,12 weeks is approximately before cycle 5,24 weeks before cycle 9; delays do not reset the elapsed-time cardiac clock.
Ask about new cough, breathlessness, fever or worsening breathing at every contact. Suspected ILD needs prompt CT/assessment, not the next scheduled scan.
monitoring.disease: Disease imaging follows the documented consultant treatment plan; NCCP does not mandate a universal CT or PET interval or routine tumour-marker schedule. Record baseline disease assessment and next response review separately from toxicity-triggered CT.
monitoring.bone: No routine Enhertu-specific DXA schedule. Use bone-density assessment if another treatment or personal fracture risk requires it.
monitoring.heart: Baseline and every 12 weeks echo/MUGA. For a new LVEF decline meeting a dose-modification threshold, repeat within 3 weeks; symptomatic CHF requires permanent discontinuation.

source_discrepancies.detail: EMA label is broader than NCCP00776v3b. Do not import first-line pertuzumab combination, HER2-ultralow/post-endocrine, lung, gastric or tumour-agnostic indications into this card.
NCCP Giraud-based recommendation expects no adjustment; EMA says dosing cannot be determined due to absent data. Review rather than automatic dose clearance.
NCCP expects no reduction with close monitoring; EMA cannot determine dose requirements at bilirubin>1.5ULN. Specialist reconciliation required.
NCCP says adult in indication but >18 in eligibility; source discrepancy retained for review.
Neither the mapped NCCP document nor retrieved EMA SmPC provides a numerical thrombocytopenia dose ladder. Platelets are recorded for clinical review; no US-label thresholds have been imported.
